description: This file is a shell script for managing git submodules; it provides commands for adding, initializing, updating, deinitializing, and listing git submodules, among other submodule-related operations.

methods.name: cmd_add
methods.description: Adds a new submodule to the repository, with options for branch, force, reference, and other parameters.

methods.name: cmd_foreach
methods.description: Executes a command in each checked-out submodule.

methods.name: cmd_init
methods.description: Registers submodules in the configuration, initializing their setup.

methods.name: cmd_deinit
methods.description: Unregisters submodules and removes their work trees.

methods.name: cmd_update
methods.description: Updates each submodule to the correct revision, performing clone and checkout as needed.

methods.name: cmd_set_branch
methods.description: Configures the default branch for a submodule.

methods.name: cmd_set_url
methods.description: Sets the remote URL for a submodule.

methods.name: cmd_status
methods.description: Lists the status of submodules, such as whether they are initialized or have different revisions checked out.

methods.name: cmd_sync
methods.description: Syncs remote URLs for submodules to match the configuration in .gitmodules.

methods.name: cmd_absorbgitdirs
methods.description: Handles absorbing git directories for submodules.
